errata.evidence: The country-code list reads 'Country of birth', 'Country of present citizenship', then 'Country fo residence'; the PDF's own text layer prints 'fo' (p27).

narrative.text: A typing slip in the list of country data elements: 'Country fo residence' means 'Country of residence'.

errata.evidence: Code 06 in the employment-status value list; the PDF's own text layer prints 'Diceased' (p32).

narrative.text: A spelling slip in the employment-status codes: 'Diceased' means 'Deceased'.

errata.evidence: The column heading of the suggested-values table, beside 'Meaning'; every other table in the document heads this column 'Value'. The PDF's own text layer prints 'Valute' (p33).

narrative.text: A spelling slip in a table heading: 'Valute' means 'Value', as in the document's other value tables.

errata.evidence: The column heading of the sex-at-birth value table, beside 'Value'; the PDF's own text layer prints 'Meaining' (p42).
